answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 44540 Country: India Title: meaning of dream Question: One night I saw myself performing salah at Kabah but there I made some mistake while performing salah. After finishing one little boy came in front of me and said a word "ilm-e-naamura." Answer ID: 44540 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 487/457/N=1434) The dream indicates that you must remove your shortcomings by getting true and authentic knowledge from authentic scholars and books and remove your faults. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
